title: Build a Pokedex in Go
description: Build a command-line Pokedex while practicing APIs, caching, and Go application structure.

lessons.title: Welcome to Build a Pokedex
lessons.instruction: A Pokedex CLI grows one command at a time. Add the missing catch command so the initial command list previews the core explore, catch, and inspect workflow.

lessons.title: Build
lessons.instruction: Keep build metadata in code so a compiled binary can identify itself. Change the version constant to the first release value.

lessons.title: Tests
lessons.instruction: Deterministic helpers make command parsing easy to test. Normalize the fixture by trimming repeated whitespace and lowercasing every token.

lessons.title: REPL
lessons.instruction: Drive the read-evaluate loop from the local input fixture. Parse each line and print only the command name, ignoring its arguments.

lessons.title: Help and Exit
lessons.instruction: A command registry keeps help discoverable and ordered. Add the exit command with its description to the registry printed by help.
lessons.expected:
help: show commands
exit: close the Pokedex

lessons.title: State
lessons.instruction: Command callbacks must mutate shared pagination state rather than copies. Pass the config by pointer so moving forward and back updates one value.

lessons.title: PokeAPI
lessons.instruction: Use an in-process HTTP fixture instead of the public PokeAPI. Request the location-area endpoint, check the response status, decode its JSON, and print both names.

lessons.title: Caching
lessons.instruction: Complete the local TTL cache. A value is a hit only when its key exists and the fixture clock has not reached its expiration time.

lessons.title: Explore
lessons.instruction: Decode the local location-area fixture. Match its nested encounter shape so explore prints every Pokémon found in the area.

lessons.title: Catch
lessons.instruction: Make capture outcomes deterministic by accepting the roll as input. A Pokémon is caught when the roll exceeds its base experience.

lessons.title: Inspect
lessons.instruction: Inspect reads a previously caught Pokémon without another API request. Print Pikachu's stored height, weight, stats, and types in a stable layout.
lessons.expected:
Name: pikachu
Height: 4
Weight: 60
Stats:
- speed: 90
- attack: 55
Types:
- electric

lessons.title: Pokedex
lessons.instruction: Map iteration is not ordered. Sort the caught Pokémon names alphabetically before printing them so the Pokedex is deterministic.

lessons.title: Submit Your Repo
lessons.instruction: A repository is ready to submit only after formatting, tests, build, and documentation all pass. Complete the local readiness checklist.
